title: Your Secret Cyber Identity
description: In the digital underground, everyone has a hidden identity. Discover your secret cyber persona that you reveal only when no one's watching.

questions.text: It's 3 AM and you just discovered a major security breach. What do you do?

options.text: Document everything and report it through proper channels
Exploit it slightly to prove it exists, then notify anonymously
Take screenshots and share with your online community
Use it to access exclusive content and digital spaces

questions.text: Your ideal digital sanctuary looks like:

options.text: A minimalist terminal with endless code streams
A cloud-based workspace accessible from anywhere
A dark room filled with glowing monitors and mysterious data
A neon-lit virtual reality lounge with ethereal music

questions.text: Someone insults your favorite technology in a public forum. You:

options.text: Write a detailed technical rebuttal with code examples
Ignoring it - your work speaks for itself
Find their digital footprint and expose their hypocrisy
Create something beautiful to show true tech appreciation

questions.text: Your username would be something like:

options.text: ZeroCool or CipherStorm
PixelNomad or CloudWalker
NeonPhoenix or SynthWave
RootAccess or DebugMaster

questions.text: If you could master one digital skill overnight, it would be:

options.text: Breaking any encryption system
Working from anywhere in the world seamlessly
Creating immersive digital experiences
Writing code that changes the world

questions.text: Your approach to learning new tech:

options.text: Read the documentation cover to cover
Jump in and figure it out as I go
Find the underground communities and learn their secrets
Watch aesthetic tutorials and get inspired
Building a new project from scratch
Working from a cafe in a different city
Exploring the dark web for interesting discoveries
Losing myself in VR worlds and digital art

questions.text: When someone says 'the internet is down':

options.text: Start troubleshooting immediately - what's the root cause?
Switch to mobile data and keep working
This is the perfect time to use my offline resources
Finally, time to disconnect and exist in the real world

questions.text: Your digital philosophy could be summarized as:

options.text: Code is poetry - elegant, efficient, beautiful
The world is my office - freedom above all
Information wants to be free - access is power
Technology should be beautiful AND functional

questions.text: If you appeared in a cyberpunk story, you'd be:

options.text: The elite coder who built the system everyone uses
The mysterious figure working from a rooftop somewhere
The digital nomad living in a smart van, everywhere and nowhere
The artist creating holographic installations in neon-lit streets

results.title: The Code Breaker
results.description: You are the architect of the digital world. In the shadows of the cyber landscape, you wield code like a master painter uses a brush - creating elegant solutions to complex problems. Your mind thinks in algorithms and your heart beats in binary. You're the one who truly understands how things work under the hood. While others use technology, you truly comprehend it.

results.title: The Digital Nomad
results.description: Location is just a state of mind to you. Your office could be a beach in Bali or a coffee shop in Tokyo - as long as there's WiFi, you're ready to work. You embody the true spirit of the remote revolution, proving that productivity has no geographic boundaries. The world is your workspace, and every new city is a fresh adventure.

results.title: The Shadow Hacker
results.description: You move through the digital world like a ghost, leaving no traces but always leaving your mark. The dark corners of the internet are your playground, and you've seen things that would blow most people's minds. You're not malicious - you just believe information should be free and systems should be tested. In a cyberpunk world, you'd be the legendary figure others whisper about.

results.title: The Neon Dreamer
results.description: You see the digital world through rose-colored pixels. While others see code, you see poetry. While others see screens, you see portals to infinite possibility. You represent the aesthetic side of technology - the beautiful intersection where art meets innovation. Your digital identity is a masterpiece of visual expression.
